prediction_question: For a Taiwan county on a date D for which a typhoon land warning (陸上颱風警報) is active or being considered, will offices and schools be fully closed (全日停止辦公及上課) on D, predicted at the statutory announcement instant on the evening before D?
prediction_time: The announcement instant is fixed by regulation, quoted from the DGPA daily closure page (2026-10-22) and repeated verbatim in the announcement attachments: full-day or morning closures must be announced between 19:00 and 22:00 the previous evening (前一日晚間7時至10時前發布); same-morning reinforced closures are announced by 04:30 and broadcast by 05:00. Features may therefore use only data published before 19:00 Taipei time on D-1 (CWA warning bulletins issued through 17:10/20:10 are the boundary cases and must be pinned per-bulletin by issuance timestamp).
target_definition: Binary per (county, date): the county's status for date D is a full-day stop of both work and school, as published by the Directorate-General of Personnel Administration (DGPA). Label sources (excluded from shipped features): the DGPA 歷次天然災害停止上班上課訊息 archive (500 announcements, 2001-present, per-county status attachments) and, for the modern era, county-portal historical CSVs (e.g. data.taipei 臺北市歷次天然災害停止上班上課訊息, fields 民國年/月/日/天然災害名稱/停止上班上課情形).

measurements.dgpa_archive_span_2026_10_22: DGPA archive: 500 announcements over 50 pages (10/page), oldest record 民國90.07.30 (CE 2001-07-30), newest 民國115.09.03 (CE 2026-09-02) - measured from informationlist pages 1 and 50, fetched anonymously 2026-10-22.
measurements.dgpa_fetch_sizes_2026_10_22: Detail page pid=13097 = 34,360 bytes; attachments 3,058-21,661 bytes; full harvest is about 50 list pages + 500 detail pages + 500-1000 attachments, on the order of 1,050-1,550 requests and 20-30 MB total (estimate labelled as such; not yet measured end-to-end). DGPA HTTPS fails strict SSL validation (chain missing Subject Key Identifier), so probes used an unverified context; the browser accepts the chain.
measurements.dgpa_attachment_formats_2026_10_22: Sampled first record of list pages 1/6/12/20/30/40/45: static per-county status table found for 2002 (Big5), 2009-era, and 2024-10-04 (UTF-8 typhoon-event table, 21,661 bytes); shell-only files (no county rows, only the statutory disclaimer block) observed for 2023-06-01, 2025-09-30 and 2026-09-02 - per-county extraction for the modern era is the one unproven step and is pinned as the first construction task.
measurements.modern_label_extraction_2026_10_31: DGPA archive attachments carry machine-parseable per-county status rows across the whole span. The 2026-10-22 'shell only' reading for 2023-06-01/2025-09-30/2026-09-02 was a probe artifact: pid=13097 (2026-09-02) carries '屏東縣|春日鄉士文村:今天停止上班、停止上課。' - a township-level closure the old probe's county/phrase list missed. Worker census east-asia-measure-002 (exit 0, 280.2 s; 976 DGPA detail/attachment requests + 50 list pages): 500/500 announcements processed, 0 fetch errors; 476/500 records carry county rows, 24 records (all in 2013) have no attachment and no county rows anywhere (label absent - measured coverage gap); 216/500 records have >=1 county-wide full-day closure; 1,333 county-day full-closure positives total (measured: sum of per-year countyday_full in the report); 100 event runs (consecutive-date clusters) with full closures, run sizes 19,10,9,5,4,3...; per-year positives 2001-2026: every year has both classes (min 2 county-day positives in 2020, max 158 in 2024). Modern canonical phrases: '今天已達停止上班及上課標準' (closed) / '今天未達停止上班及上課標準' (open); old era uses 照常辦公/停止辦公 variants; district-qualified rows (township/school closures) appear from 2011 and must be excluded from the county-wide label. Classifier fixtures: 13130 (2026-10-24) 13 full + 9 open; 13097 (2026-09-02) 1 partial; 7100 (2011-03-11, Big5, descriptive attachment name) 5 full + 1 partial; 7018 (2011-08-28) 2 full + 19 open. Report: probe/measure_report_2026-10-31.json.
measurements.effective_date_semantics_2026_10_31: Archive records are keyed by ANNOUNCEMENT date (title = NNN年M月D日...情形), and rows reference one effective day via phrase: '今天' rows -> effective = title date; '明天' rows -> effective = title date + 1. Sampled 10 records across 2001-2026: 9/10 are entirely 今天-phrased; one (2024-07-27, Gaemi) mixes 16 今天 + 10 明天 rows; one further 2025 record (114年11月11日) is 明天-phrased. Most records therefore carry the same-day (final) status for the title date; a minority (observed 2024+) are previous-evening announcements for the next day. CONSTRUCTION RULE: map each row's effective date from its 今天/明天 phrase, never from the title alone. The census's per-year counts attribute positives by title date, so a minority of 2024+ records shifts by +1 day; this does not change any split-capacity conclusion.
measurements.daily_view_not_parameterisable_2026_10_3: probe_modern_label.py: /typh/daily/nds.html returns a byte-identical 13,113 B response for 6 date-parameter variants (?date=2024-10-03, ?d=1131003, ?ymd=1131003, ?yy&mm&dd, ...) and contains no form/date controls; the daily view answers the current day only and cannot serve historical labels. County-portal registers exist as a cross-check: data.gov.tw 84387 (Taichung, CSV 西元年,月,日,災害類別,狀況 - 80 rows 2018-07-10..2026-06-10, 7,304 B, fetched 2026-10-31) and 161017 (Taoyuan, opendata.tycg.gov.tw); they are per-county and not needed for the primary label path.

prior_art: Taiwan civil typhoon-day predictor apps and hackathon projects (predict whether tomorrow is a typhoon day); no public benchmark dataset of the closure decision was found in any catalog
novelty_check.theirs: DGPA publishes the closure record (labels only, as human-readable announcement pages); CWA publishes forecasts and the typhoon database (features only); consumer apps and hackathon demos predict typhoon days but ship no dataset, no splits and no scored contract
novelty_check.ours: First ML-ready benchmark of the Taiwan county-day typhoon-closure decision: 2001-2026 panel built from the DGPA statutory announcement archive (the only public per-county closure record) with the prediction instant fixed by regulation at 19:00-22:00 the prior evening, features limited to CWA typhoon warning bulletins and prior-day closure status available before that instant, year-based splits with clustered positives reported per typhoon, and persistence/calendar baselines shipped beside any model
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.

split_strategy: County-day event panel from the DGPA archive (label) + CWA TDB warning periods and bulletins (population and features). Population: county-days within typhoon land-warning periods 2001-2026 for the 22 counties. Label: county-wide full-day closure on the effective date (phrase-mapped 今天/明天; district/school-qualified rows and half-day closures are excluded from the positive class - they may form a separate partial class). Candidate windows (temporal, disjoint): train 2001-2012 (measured by the east-asia-measure-002 census: 491 county-day positives over 91 announcement records), eval 2013-2018 (403 positives measured over 138 records; note 2013 has 24 label-absent records - usable dates only), holdout 2019-2026 (439 positives measured over 271 records). Both classes present in every year 2001-2026 (min 2 positives, 2020). Clustered effective sample: 100 event runs with full closures (a national closure day contributes 22 correlated positives) - clustered counts must be reported with scores.
